rule: Part 1 AP6, v1.1 (CR 61 finding): an act-aware yes. When the read-back being approved is itself a cancellation (act_kind 'cancel'), the listed words stop vetoing, so 'Yes, cancel it' approves the cancellation. Every other negation still vetoes ('Don't cancel it' is not a yes). Without act_kind, AP6 is exactly 1.0.1. approval-language.json is unchanged (byte-identical).
